{{Youmay|a title in [[Slith]] society|[[First Mate/Legends|the generic term applied to a vessel's second in command]]}}
'''First Mate''' was a title given among [[Slith]] clans to the senior mate of the alpha male. The First Mate had authority over all other females and young in the clan. [[Dresk Kist]] was First Mate in her tribe.
